### 中文简介
**批量删除 · Bulk Delete** 用于替代原版繁琐的逐个拆除操作，支持成片框选清理、精细过滤与上一步操作撤回：
- **三种框选模式**：支持**矩形**（跟随镜头或锁定正南北）、**多边形**（最多 64 顶点）与**自由笔画**选区，实时显示面积、周长与格数；锁定选区后可**左键补选、右键剔除**。 - **精细筛选与安全保护**：支持按**建筑分区**（住宅/商业/工业/办公/服务）与**资产类型**（道路管网、树木、摆件、贴花、地表、车辆市民等）过滤；联动原版地下视图；默认开启删除确认、重点/市政建筑二次确认，自动保护地图边缘外部连接与行政区。 - **独立全局撤回与分步恢复**：支持 **`Ctrl+Z` 一键撤回上一步**，覆盖批量删除、新建建造、推土机单删、道路/建筑升级替换、分区涂刷与地形改造；道路撤回尽量原地复原以减少相邻路网重连，建筑支持一键原子重建。 - *撤回边界说明*：撤回仅尽力恢复几何与基础属性，**不还原住户、就业、经济等模拟状态**，车辆与市民不支持撤回。重要操作请以读档为准。 - **高亮配色自定义**：提供 18 项选区与高亮颜色、3 项透明度调节及 4 套一键预设（含色盲友好模式）。 - **适配与反馈**：基于 Cities: Skylines II `1.6.4f1` 构建并测试（1.6.x 其他版本将以兼容模式加载）。反馈问题请附上 `MarqueeDelete.status.log` 与 `Player.log`。

### English
> ### ⚠️ Important AI Disclosure & Risk Warning > > **The entire creation process of this mod is fully controlled by DeepSeek, GPT, and Gemini AI.** > > All C# code, UI components, test suites, cover art, and this description were generated and directed by those AI models. The author is **not a programmer**, cannot write code, and only provides ideas and in-game testing. > > **Please understand the risks before subscribing:** > - May cause **FPS drops, stuttering, slower simulation, or stalled vehicles**; > - Bulk deletion or undo may cause **broken road/pedestrian links, disconnected buildings, or terrain/zone glitches**; > - In worst cases, it may **freeze, crash, or corrupt your current session**. > > **Always back up your saves before installing** and test on a new save first. Do not subscribe if these risks are unacceptable.
### Overview
**Bulk Delete** replaces tedious single-click bulldozing with fast area selection, granular filtering, and step-by-step undo:
- **Three Selection Modes**: **Box** (camera-aligned or North-South locked), **Polygon** (up to 64 vertices), and **Freehand Stroke** with live area/perimeter readouts. Fine-tune selections with left-click add / right-click remove. - **Filters & Safety Guards**: Filter by zone type (R/C/I/O/Service) and asset category (roads/networks, trees, props, decals, surfaces, vehicles/citizens). Follows the vanilla underground toggle, confirms before deletion (with a second confirmation listing service/unique buildings), and protects outside connections & districts. - **Standalone Global Undo (`Ctrl+Z`) & Selective Restore**: Undo your previous bulk delete, build, bulldoze, road/building upgrade or replacement, zone painting, or terrain edit. Adjacent roads are restored in-place where possible, and buildings rebuild atomically. - *Scope note*: Undo restores geometry and basic properties only — households, jobs, economy, vehicles, and citizens are not restored. Always keep manual saves for critical rollbacks. - **Visual Customization**: 18 highlight colors, 3 opacity sliders, and 4 built-in presets (including Colorblind Safe). - **Compatibility**: Built and tested on Cities: Skylines II `1.6.4f1` (other `1.6.x` builds load in compatibility mode). Please attach `MarqueeDelete.status.log` and `Player.log` when reporting bugs.
